failure_modes.recovery: Send Fabric toJSON output; embedded images must be PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF data URLs.
failure_modes.when: canvas_json is not valid JSON, or an embedded image fails upload hygiene

failure_modes.recovery: List projects via edit_project_list and use a returned id.
failure_modes.when: the project id does not exist in your scope

description: Save changes to an existing canvas project by id — the autosave door: send only the fields that changed (name, canvas_json, width, height, thumbnail_data_url), everything else on the row is left alone. A canvas_json you send goes through the same image-externalization and hygiene refusal as edit_project_create (embedded images become R2 keys; SVG, unrecognized types, oversized images, or a still-too-large canvas refuse the whole save). version is bumped by the door itself on every save and thumbnail_key is server-minted from thumbnail_data_url — both refuse if you pass them directly. NEXT: edit_project_read to confirm the saved version.

expected_updated_at.description: Optional compare-and-set guard: the updated_at you last read. Mismatch returns CONFLICT with the current value.

thumbnail_data_url.description: Optional thumbnail as a data: URL (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF, max 2MB) — externalized into thumbnail_key the same way embedded canvas images are. Omit to skip thumbnail externalization (create: no thumbnail_key is set; update: the existing thumbnail_key is left unchanged).

name: edit_project_update
